output.review_comment: The implementation correctly fixes the failing tests and properly implements three rules for title casing: (1) preserving mixed-case words, (2) handling small words based on position, and (3) capitalizing other words. However, the code now handles a special case for words after colons (subtitle capitalization) that is NOT documented in the docstring. Rule 2 of the docstring should be updated to reflect that small words are capitalized if they appear after a colon, not just at the start/end of the text. This documentation gap should be fixed to avoid confusion for future maintainers.
